```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, c.is_assembly
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id
    WHERE m.model_code = 'AL4-160OAK35-0520'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION
    SELECT cb.child_component_id, c.is_assembly
    FROM bom b
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = b.component_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cb.child_component_id
    WHERE b.is_assembly
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT component_id) AS part_count
FROM bom
WHERE is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Resolve bundle to its item SKUs
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE s.sku_code = 'BDL-DE-0329'
),
-- Map item SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT sm.model_id, sm.qty AS sku_model_qty, bi.bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Model BOM edges (current)
model_edges AS (
    SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id, mb.qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Component BOM edges (current)
comp_edges AS (
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive expansion from each model
expansion AS (
    -- Level 0: model -> component
    SELECT sm.model_id,
           me.component_id,
           CAST(sm.sku_model_qty * sm.bundle_qty * me.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_edges me ON me.model_id = sm.model_id
    UNION ALL
    -- Recurse through assemblies
    SELECT e.model_id,
           ce.child_component_id,
           e.qty * ce.qty
    FROM expansion e
    JOIN comp_edges ce ON ce.parent_component_id = e.component_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM expansion e
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'CON-328-BLK-00970'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Resolve bundle BDL-JP-0096 to its item SKUs and quantities
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE s.sku_code = 'BDL-JP-0096'
),
-- Map item SKUs to company models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty, bi.bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Expand model BOM recursively to leaf parts
model_expansion AS (
    -- Base: direct components of each model
    SELECT
        sm.model_id,
        sm.bundle_qty * sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: expand assemblies via component BOM
    SELECT
        me.model_id,
        me.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_expansion me
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = me.component_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cb.child_component_id
    WHERE me.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(me.total_qty), 0) AS units
FROM model_expansion me
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = me.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FAS-477-BLK-01660'
  AND me.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Find the bundle SKU
bundle AS (
    SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-US-0160'
),
-- 2. Item SKUs in the bundle
items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle b ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
),
-- 3. Models for each item SKU
item_models AS (
    SELECT i.item_sku_id, i.bundle_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM items i
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = i.item_sku_id
),
-- 4. Model BOM edges (current)
model_edges AS (
    SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id, mb.qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- 5. Component BOM edges (current)
comp_edges AS (
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- 6. Recursive expansion: start from each model's direct components
--    path: model_id, component_id, accumulated qty per one unit of model
expansion AS (
    SELECT me.model_id, me.component_id, CAST(me.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM model_edges me
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.model_id, ce.child_component_id, e.qty * ce.qty
    FROM expansion e
    JOIN comp_edges ce ON ce.parent_component_id = e.component_id
),
-- 7. Aggregate per model: qty of target part per one unit of model
model_part AS (
```

```sql
exploded AS (

    SELECT

        o.order_date,

        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS bom_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id

      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle path: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model -> model BOM
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        ol.qty * bi.qty AS line_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS bom_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku bs ON bs.sku_id = l.sku_id AND bs.is_bundle = TRUE
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = bs.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-20'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- 2. Recursively explode assemblies down to parts
bom_tree AS (
    SELECT
        e.order_id,
        e.order_date,
        e.line_qty,
        e.component_id,
        e.bom_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        e.line_qty * e.bom_qty AS total_qty
    FROM exploded e

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        bt.order_id,
        bt.order_date,
        bt.line_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,

        bt.line_qty * bt.qty_per_unit * cb.qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bt.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= bt.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR bt.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
```

```sql
    SELECT model_id 
    FROM company_model 
    WHERE model_code = 'NO3-180BLK75-0463'
),

    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty as model_qty
    FROM model_bom mb

    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    FROM model_components mc

    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: direct components from model BOM that are assemblies

        mc.component_id,
        mc.model_qty as total_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand assembly children
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        ep.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ep.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
```

```sql
       OR c.component_id IN (SELECT child_component_id FROM bom_edges)
),
recursive_bom AS (
    SELECT 
        e.component_id AS root_component_id,
        e.component_id AS current_component_id,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier,
        e.is_assembly AS current_is_assembly
    FROM exploded_components e
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        rb.root_component_id,
        be.child_component_id,
        rb.qty_multiplier * be.qty,
        ec.is_assembly
    FROM recursive_bom rb
    JOIN bom_edges be ON rb.current_component_id = be.parent_component_id
    JOIN exploded_components ec ON be.child_component_id = ec.component_id
    WHERE rb.current_is_assembly = true
),
part_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        rb.root_component_id,
        SUM(rb.qty_multiplier) AS qty_per_unit

    GROUP BY rb.root_component_id
),
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to,
        1 AS depth
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to,
        bp.depth + 1
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON cb.child_component_id = bp.parent_component_id
),
-- Calculate total quantity of the part per parent component (multiplying along paths)
component_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_component_id,
        SUM(qty) AS part_qty_per_component
    FROM bom_paths
    GROUP BY parent_component_id
),
-- Get all SKUs and their model mappings (non-bundle)
sku_model_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_qty,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE sm.sku_id NOT IN (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle = true)
),
-- Expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs
bundle_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_item_qty,
        sme.model_id,
        sme.model_qty,
        sme.component_id,
        sme.component_qty,
        sme.valid_from,
        sme.valid_to
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model_expanded sme ON bi.item_sku_id = sme.sku_id
),
-- Combine non-bundle and bundle SKU expansions
all_sku_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        model_id,
        model_qty,
        component_id,
        component_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM sku_model_expanded
    WHERE sku_id NOT IN (SELECT bundle_sku_id FROM bundle_item)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        model_id,
        model_qty * bundle_item_qty AS model_qty,
        component_id,
        component_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bundle_expanded
),
-- Join with the part quantity per component
sku_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        asc_.sku_id,
        asc_.model_id,
        asc_.model_qty,
        asc_.component_id,
        asc_.component_qty,
        asc_.valid_from,
        asc_.valid_to,
        cpq.part_qty_per_component
    FROM all_sku_components asc_
    JOIN component_part_qty cpq ON asc_.component_id = cpq.parent_component_id

-- Calculate total part quantity per SKU (model_qty * component_qty * part_qty_per_component)

    FROM sku_part_qty
    GROUP BY sku_id

amazon_listings AS (
    SELECT 
        l.listing_id,

completed_order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,

        ol.qty AS order_qty,

    FROM order_line ol

    JOIN amazon_listings al ON ol.listing_id = al.listing_id

        stpq.total_part_qty,
        spq.valid_from,
        spq.valid_to
    FROM completed_order_lines col

    JOIN sku_part_qty spq ON al.sku_id = spq.sku_id
```

```sql
    UNION ALL
```

```sql
        ct.item_sku_id,

        ct.bundle_item_qty,
        ct.model_id,
        ct.current_component_id,
        ct.path_qty,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM component_tree ct
    JOIN component c ON ct.current_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include direct model BOM parts that might not go through recursive step
    SELECT 
        im.item_sku_id,
        im.bundle_item_qty,
```

```sql
    FROM component
```

```sql
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),

-- Get current model BOM edges (valid as of 2026-10-01)
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),

-- Recursive expansion of component assemblies to find all parts at any level
component_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.parent_component_id AS root_assembly_id,
        c.child_component_id AS component_id,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_component_bom c
    WHERE c.parent_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        cp.root_assembly_id,
        c.child_component_id AS component_id,
        cp.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_parts cp
    JOIN current_component_bom c ON cp.component_id = c.parent_component_id
    WHERE cp.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
),

-- All component-to-part mappings (direct parts + expanded assemblies)
all_component_parts AS (
    -- Direct parts (non-assembly components that are children)
    SELECT 
        c.parent_component_id AS root_component_id,
        c.child_component_id AS component_id,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_component_bom c
    JOIN component child ON c.child_component_id = child.component_id
    WHERE child.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from expanded assemblies
    SELECT 
        root_assembly_id AS root_component_id,
        component_id,
        total_qty
    FROM component_parts
    WHERE component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = false)
),

-- Find all models that contain the target part (directly or through components)
models_with_part AS (
    -- Direct: model -> part
    SELECT DISTINCT m.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom m
    WHERE m.component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part)
    
    UNION
    
    -- Through component: model -> component -> ... -> part
    SELECT DISTINCT m.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom m
    JOIN all_component_parts acp ON m.component_id = acp.root_component_id
    WHERE acp.component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part)
),

    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sm.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
)
```

```sql
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
```

```sql
    FROM sku_model
    WHERE model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
```

```sql
    FROM sales_sku s

    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku s ON bi.item_sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id

        ol.qty AS line_qty,
```

```sql
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN ca_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),
-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get their item SKUs with bundle qty * item qty
-- For non-bundle SKUs, keep as-is
expanded_sku_qty AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        osq.line_qty AS order_qty,
        osq.sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier  -- not in a bundle, so multiplier is 1
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        osq.line_qty AS order_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Get model quantities from SKUs (non-bundle items that map to models)
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        esq.order_qty * esq.bundle_multiplier * sm.qty AS total_model_qty,
        sm.model_id
    FROM expanded_sku_qty esq
    JOIN sku_model sm ON esq.sku_id = sm.sku_id
)
-- Sum up by model and get top 3
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM sku_model_qty smq
JOIN company_model cm ON smq.model_id = cm.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(smq.total_model_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Amazon-US-20 in 2025 with their lines
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, ol.line_no, ol.listing_id, ol.qty as order_line_qty, ol.unit_price
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-20'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),

-- Resolve each order line to SKUs and their quantities (handling bundles)
sku_quantities AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly from listings
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.line_no,
        so.listing_id,
        so.order_line_qty,
        sk.sku_id,
        sk.is_bundle,
        so.order_line_qty as sku_qty  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN listing li ON so.listing_id = li.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON li.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.line_no,
        so.listing_id,
        so.order_line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        sk2.is_bundle,
        so.order_line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty  -- multiply by bundle item qty
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN listing li ON so.listing_id = li.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON li.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON sk.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk2 ON bi.item_sku_id = sk2.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each SKU (non-bundle items)
model_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        sq.order_id,
        sq.order_date,
        sq.line_no,
        sq.listing_id,
        sq.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sq.sku_qty * sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_quantities sq
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sq.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sq.is_bundle = false
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOMs
component_explosion AS (
    -- Base: start with models and their direct components
    SELECT 
        mq.order_id,
        mq.order_date,
        mq.line_no,
        mq.listing_id,
        mq.model_qty,
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        mq.model_qty * mb.qty as total_qty
    FROM model_quantities mq
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mq.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= mq.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mq.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        ce.order_id,
        ce.order_date,
        ce.line_no,
        ce.listing_id,
        ce.model_qty,
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        ce.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ce.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE ce.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= ce.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ce.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum total consumed quantity for the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_consumed
FROM component_explosion
WHERE is_assembly = false
  AND component_code = 'LEG-407-OAK-00192';
```

```sql
        ol.order_line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty per bundle
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models with quantities
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.order_line_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty  -- total model quantity needed
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM on the order date
model_bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with models and their direct components
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assembly components
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.line_no,
        mbe.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mbe.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        mbe.level + 1
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)

),
```

```sql
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM completed_orders co
    JOIN order_line ol ON co.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Expand bundles: for each order line, get the underlying SKUs and their quantities
-- If it's a bundle, explode to item SKUs; if not, keep as is
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs (direct model mapping)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * COALESCE(bi.qty, 1) as total_sku_qty,
        COALESCE(bi.item_sku_id, ol.sku_id) as final_sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.is_bundle = true AND bi.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false OR bi.item_sku_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items that are themselves bundles (handle nested bundles if needed)
    -- But per rules, bundle items map to models, so we assume no nested bundles for simplicity
    -- Actually, let's handle one level of bundle nesting just in case
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * bi1.qty * bi2.qty as total_sku_qty,
        bi2.item_sku_id as final_sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi1 ON ss.is_bundle = true AND bi1.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss2 ON bi1.item_sku_id = ss2.sku_id AND ss2.is_bundle = true
    JOIN bundle_item bi2 ON bi2.bundle_sku_id = ss2.sku_id
),

-- Get model quantities for each expanded SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.total_sku_qty * sm.qty as total_model_qty,
        sm.model_id
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.final_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get top-level components from model BOM valid on order date
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.total_model_qty * mb.qty as total_component_qty,
        mb.component_id
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursively explode component BOMs
recursive_components AS (
    -- Base: components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.order_date,
        mc.total_component_qty as qty,
        mc.component_id
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        rc.order_id,
        rc.order_date,
        rc.qty * cb.qty as qty,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id
    FROM recursive_components rc
    JOIN component c ON rc.component_id = c.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON rc.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
        AND cb.valid_from <= rc.order_date
        AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR rc.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up quantities for the target part

FROM recursive_components rc
JOIN target_part tp ON rc.component_id = tp.component_id
```

```sql
        sku_id,
        sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_qty
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expand to their item SKUs
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
),
-- Map SKUs to models, accounting for bundle expansion
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        be.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty * be.bundle_qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM bundle_expansion be
    JOIN sku_model sm ON be.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get completed orders in DE in 2025 with their lines
de_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'DE'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
-- Calculate model units sold
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.model_id,
        SUM(deo.line_qty * stm.total_model_qty) AS total_units
    FROM de_orders_2025 deo
    JOIN listing l ON deo.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sku_to_model stm ON l.sku_id = stm.sku_id
    GROUP BY stm.model_id
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_sales ms
JOIN company_model cm ON ms.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY ms.total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
        mb.component_id AS child_id,

    SELECT 
        bt.child_id AS parent_id,
        bt.qty_at_level AS parent_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS child_id,
        bt.qty_at_level * cb.qty AS qty_at_level,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Start from the bundle SKU, find its item SKUs
    SELECT 
        'sku' AS parent_kind,
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS path_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-JP-0096'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: traverse the BOM
    -- From SKU -> model, or model -> component, or assembly component -> component
    SELECT 
        bp.child_kind AS parent_kind,
        bp.child_code AS parent_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        bp.path_qty * c.qty AS path_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition c 
      ON c.parent_kind = bp.child_kind 
     AND c.parent_code = bp.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      -- Stop when we reach a part (non-assembly component)
      AND NOT (bp.child_kind = 'component' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component comp 
          WHERE comp.component_code = bp.child_code 
            AND comp.is_assembly = false
      ))
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bp.path_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom_paths bp
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = bp.child_code
WHERE bp.child_kind = 'component'
  AND comp.component_code = 'FAS-477-BLK-01660'
  AND comp.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
        comp.component_code,
        uc.qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN company_model c ON uc.parent_code = c.model_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'

    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all assembly -> component compositions that are currently valid
assembly_to_component AS (
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id AS parent_component_id,
        parent.component_code AS parent_component_code,
        child.component_id AS child_component_id,
        child.component_code AS child_component_code,
        uc.qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component parent ON uc.parent_code = parent.component_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'component' AND parent.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component child ON uc.child_code = child.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- Recursive CTE: explode all model -> component paths, following assemblies down to parts
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct model -> component links
    SELECT 
        mtc.model_id,
        mtc.model_code,
        mtc.component_id AS leaf_component_id,
        mtc.component_code AS leaf_component_code,
        mtc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_to_component mtc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow assembly -> component links
    SELECT 
        be.model_id,
        be.model_code,
        atc.child_component_id AS leaf_component_id,
        atc.child_component_code AS leaf_component_code,
        be.total_qty * atc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN assembly_to_component atc ON be.leaf_component_id = atc.parent_component_id
)
-- Count distinct models that contain the target component at any level
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) AS model_count
FROM bom_explosion
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all model codes that contain the target part at any level
models_with_part AS (
    -- Base case: direct model -> component edges where component is the target part
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN component comp ON c.child_code = comp.component_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND comp.component_code = 'GEA-767-OAK-00892'
      AND comp.is_assembly = false
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: model -> assembly component -> ... -> target part
    SELECT 
        mc.parent_code AS model_code,
        mc.qty * child.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition mc
    JOIN component comp ON mc.child_code = comp.component_code
    JOIN models_with_part child ON mc.child_code = child.model_code
    WHERE mc.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND mc.child_kind = 'component'
      AND comp.is_assembly = true
      AND mc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mc.valid_to IS NULL OR mc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Also need to handle assembly components containing other components
-- Actually, let me restructure: we need to explode from any starting point down to parts
-- Let's build a proper BOM explosion from models down to parts

-- First get all composition edges valid as of current date
valid_compositions AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- BOM explosion: start from models, go down through components
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: model -> direct child (component or we need to handle via model->component)
    SELECT 
        v.parent_code AS root_model,
        v.child_code AS child_code,
        v.child_kind AS child_kind,
        v.qty AS qty
    FROM valid_compositions v
    WHERE v.parent_kind = 'model'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: assembly component -> its children
    SELECT 
        b.root_model,
        v.child_code,
        v.child_kind,
        b.qty * v.qty AS qty
    FROM bom_explosion b
    JOIN valid_compositions v ON b.child_code = v.parent_code AND v.parent_kind = 'component'
    WHERE b.child_kind = 'component'
      -- Only continue if current node is an assembly
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM component c WHERE c.component_code = b.child_code AND c.is_assembly = true)
),

-- Find models that contain the target part
models_with_target_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.root_model AS model_code
    FROM bom_explosion b
    JOIN component c ON b.child_code = c.component_code
    WHERE b.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.component_code = 'GEA-767-OAK-00892'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
),

-- Find SKUs that map to these models (non-bundle SKUs only)
skus_with_target_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.sku_id
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN valid_compositions v ON s.sku_code = v.parent_code AND v.parent_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN models_with_target_part m ON v.child_code = m.model_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
      AND v.child_kind = 'model'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS non_bundle_sku_count
FROM skus_with_target_part
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the store_id for Walmart-UK-22
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Walmart-UK-22'
),

-- Get all completed orders from target store in 2024
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_sku_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        ss.sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle,
        ol.qty AS line_qty
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN order_line ol ON so.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode compositions
-- We track: order_id, order_date, current item code, current kind, quantity multiplier, depth
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start from SKU order lines
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.sku_code AS current_code,
        'sku' AS current_kind,
        osl.line_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        0 AS depth
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow composition edges that are valid on order_date
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.order_date,
        uc.child_code AS current_code,
        uc.child_kind AS current_kind,
        e.qty_multiplier * uc.qty AS qty_multiplier,
        e.depth + 1 AS depth
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON e.current_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND e.current_kind = uc.parent_kind
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= e.order_date 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get all leaf-level component explosions (deepest level for each path)
-- We need to find components that are parts (is_assembly = false) or have no further children
leaf_components AS (
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.order_date,
        e.current_code AS component_code,
        e.qty_multiplier AS total_qty
    FROM exploded e
    WHERE e.current_kind = 'component'
      AND e.current_code = 'FOO-140-GRY-02859'
)

-- Sum up all consumptions of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lc.total_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM leaf_components lc
JOIN component c ON lc.component_code = c.component_code
WHERE c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- Step 1: Get all completed order lines in CA in 2024 with their SKU and quantity
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Step 2: Expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs (with quantities)
-- For non-bundles, this is just the SKU itself with qty 1
-- For bundles, we follow composition edges
bundle_expansion AS (
    -- Base: non-bundle SKUs (direct model mappings)
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        osq.sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier,
        osq.is_bundle
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: bundle SKUs -> their direct item SKUs
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        false AS is_bundle
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN u_composition uc ON osq.sku_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = true
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: handle nested bundles (bundle SKU -> bundle SKU -> ...)
    SELECT 
        be.listing_id,
        be.line_qty,
        be.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        be.bundle_multiplier * uc.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        false AS is_bundle
    FROM bundle_expansion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.item_sku_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE be.is_bundle = true
),

-- Step 3: Get all leaf item SKUs (non-bundle) with their total quantities
leaf_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        line_qty,
        item_sku_code,
        bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_expansion
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include the original non-bundle SKUs from order_sku_qty
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        line_qty,
        sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_sku_qty
    WHERE is_bundle = false
),

-- Step 4: Map item SKUs to company models
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        lsq.listing_id,
        lsq.line_qty,
        lsq.item_sku_code,
        lsq.bundle_multiplier,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_per_sku_qty
    FROM leaf_sku_qty lsq
    JOIN u_composition uc ON lsq.item_sku_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Step 5: Calculate total model units sold
model_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        smq.model_code,
        SUM(smq.line_qty * smq.bundle_multiplier * smq.model_per_sku_qty) AS total_units
    FROM sku_model_qty smq
    GROUP BY smq.model_code
)

SELECT model_code
FROM model_totals
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS root_sku,
        uc.child_code AS current_code,
        'sku' AS current_kind,
        osq.line_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,

    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = osq.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = true

        e.root_sku,
        uc.child_code AS current_code,
        'model' AS current_kind,
        e.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        cm.model_code,

    WHERE e.current_kind = 'sku'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map to model VI7-180BLK56-0347, either directly or through bundles
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty,
        1 AS sku_qty,  -- Each SKU is 1 unit of itself at top level
        s.sku_code AS root_sku,
        0 AS depth
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE c.child_code = 'VI7-180BLK56-0347'
        AND s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs -> item SKUs -> model (recursive through bundle levels)
    SELECT 
        child_sku.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        sm.model_qty,
        uc.qty * sm.sku_qty AS sku_qty,
        COALESCE(sm.root_sku, parent_sku.sku_code) AS root_sku,
        sm.depth + 1
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN sales_sku parent_sku ON parent_sku.sku_code = uc.parent_code AND parent_sku.is_bundle = true
    JOIN sales_sku child_sku ON child_sku.sku_code = uc.child_code
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND sm.model_code = 'VI7-180BLK56-0347'
),
-- Get unique SKU-to-model mappings with total quantity multiplier per root SKU
sku_model_multiplier AS (
    SELECT 
        root_sku,
        MAX(sku_qty * model_qty) AS total_model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_to_model
    GROUP BY root_sku
),
-- Get all completed order lines in 2024 with their SKUs
order_lines_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code

    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
```

```sql
    -- Base: direct SKU -> model mappings

        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundle SKU -> item SKU, then follow existing paths
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code AS root_sku,
        uc.qty * sp.multiplier AS multiplier,
        sp.depth + 1
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
    JOIN sku_paths sp ON sp.root_sku = uc.child_code
```
